name: Deore XT SG crankset (1991 reference)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 730 g for the FC-M730-SG triple crankset: 170 mm arms with 46/36/26T chainrings; excludes the separately listed BB-M730 bottom bracket. This is the 1991 SG reference, not the later Round Gear SG-X assembly catalogued as FC-M730.
